reviews.text: Nice ancient town with good food. Street food here majority are nice except the rushan, tofu. We found nice restaurant for lunch, food were tasty and price reasonable. The entire area is not big so it’s not making you tired for walking the entire space. There is no need to take tourist cart, they will always exaggerate things telling you it’s tiring to walk but in reality the cart takes you to very short distance and it’s just sending you to another entrance, not even entering into the gate. No vehicle allowed inside the ancient town so remember this don’t be fooled.

Xizhou Ancient Town, located 20 km north of Dali Old Town in Yunnan, is a well-preserved Bai ethnic minority settlement with a history way back over a thousand years. I had an experience meeting an alpaca at a chinese tea shop. I like their flower cake and the Xizhou pizza.

Unlike old town in other city like Lijiang or Dali, this is a very large old town where many normal people live inside, just like a small outskirt town. Mix of commercial and not so commercialized like other old town. Can spend full day here slowly enjoying the life style here
Personally I find this town nicer than the one in Lijiang. It is less crowded and more peaceful. We chanced upon a very nice coffee place and the deco is absolutely gorgeous.

Xizhou Ancient Town is an interesting place to explore, offering a mix of history and leisure. You can see the little sightseeing train running through the grassland, stroll through beautiful traditional courtyards and gardens, and enjoy the variety of local shops and restaurants. It’s a pleasant spot to experience both culture and relaxation in one visit.
A visit to 喜洲古镇 is absolutely essential for anyone in Dali. It is a truly eye-opening experience.

Another ancient city to be visited here, for check-in @ photo shoot. There are actress came here for movie shooting, and that's why it become famous. Lots of small stall can be visited for souvenir too! Just the traffic@ usage of local motorcycles move around with the same walkway, really not convenient. Be careful on it.
Xizhou ancient town, one of best ancient town in yunnan, so many handcrafted goods like pottery and hand dyed cloth, unique beverages n pies that put rose petals as ingridients..
of all the ancient towns in Dali, this one is the one which is most authentic and I would say a must visit. Skip the rest and choose this if U only have limited time!

Quite a commercial place where you were asked to follow a tour in a group of people before accessing the place yourself or taking the mini train to the paddy field The tour was filled with aggressive tourists I think it is more enjoyable to do it yourself Anyhow it is a stopover point if you traveling in Dali
In addition to the famous residential museum, there are a lot of shops all around the area for snacking and other kinds of shopping. You will need to purchase a ticket to get in the area (RMB $45).
Xizhou Ancient Town has a lot to offer! Food, snacks, souvenirs and others! The experience was definitely worth the travel from Dali Ancient Town.

It's a great place to visit. A beautiful Buddha temple in the tranquil location is like being close to the gods. DALI is indeed a must on China's tourist plan. The people are warm and welcoming. The food is excellent . I thoroughly enjoyed riding the escooter around the lake . It's a place one must visit.

We plan to visit as many old town as we can. On our E-bike, we rode to this ancient town. Luckily it was very far from our hotel. It was a very straight forward ride. It was raining when we arrived. So we bought rain coat and rain boots! We didn't get to take much pictures as all of us we trying to find shelter! We tried a few small dishes along the way. I wish we could have spent a little bit more time but the weather was not coorperative...there were also a few 网红打卡点 along the way before reaching the town that you can stop and take a few nice pictures. But be ready to wait in line!

I only visited the place briefly so that I could have more time to explore other places. Generally, the ancient village is similar to Dali Ancient Town in concept. These ancient towns have become commercialised whereby shops sell the same crafts, restaurants sell the same type of mee xian or steamboat.

Xizhou is a nice village with some nice authentic architecture and feel. It's become modern by the beer shops and coffee shops, but the infrastructure remains the same. A nice place to visit and even stay for a day.
Try the fish pedicure, you might scream and giggle at first but after one hour and $5, I had the softest feet ever. The atmosphere at night is amazing, very touristic but in good taste.
Took public bus here from Dali Ancient City, shops are similar, the view and scenaries are different, more out of town vibe. The sausage is a must for me at each place, so sedap (delicious).
A nice ancient town located by Erhai Lake. There’re not many tourists in comparision with Shuanglang Ancient Town.
Popular tourist spot in Dali City. One of the biggest ancient town you can visit. Plenty of local food and shops. Ancient building and culture are visible. Prices are affordable. People are friendly.
Visited the Yan family house which build in 1935. Worth seeing. And plenty of small little things selling on the streets.
It's a small town. Nothing much to see and buy. Plus point is able to see Jade Dragon Snow Mountain from the car park if the weather is cleared.

Xizhou is about 20km North of Dali old town. This place is a quite village with many vendors selling food and trinkets. Try the famous dishes such as Xizhou Baba which is savoury or sweet pastry, and claypot noodles. Other than that walk around and have a look at the locals life's. I think this place is good for an hour stay.

We came here to experience the Sandaocha tea ceremony. The performances by the Bai ethnic minority were endearing, and was a good effort. Its a small but interesting ancient town, and beautifully preserved architectures and old houses.
Nice place to hang before 10 all shop yet open. Come later to have many choice of food n snack. I tried the liang pi with soy. Taste so good!!
not a must visit place. Because the other old town is much better and free entrance
Pleasant to work around n do some shopping especially the tie dyed clothes n scarves, so beautiful, prob need to bargain. Lots of places to eat n stop for a drink too.
just another touristy spot in Dali. if you've already been to one of those ancient towns, don't bother.
It is a peaceful village. A lot of shops located along the street that you can enjoy shopping and dining.
Quaint old town with lots of character and beautiful indigo tye-dye artisan crafts!
Rather quiet village. Worth it if you walk outside of the tourist paths/schedules.

喜洲古鎮位於大理古城以北，東臨洱海、西枕蒼山，是一座擁有千年歷史的白族文化名鎮。這裡保存了最完整的白族民居建築群（三坊一照壁、四合五天井），以雕樑畫棟和精緻門樓聞名。古鎮以「喜洲粑粑」、轉角樓、轉角樓雪糕、網紅麥田及稻田風景為特色，是體現白族傳統文化的重要小鎮
喜州民居位於中國雲南省大理市喜洲鎮，2001 年被列為第五批全國重點文物保護單位。 喜洲鎮地處洱海西北岸，是大理市北上的必經之道，自古即為白族的聚居地。喜洲建築群是典型的白族民居建築，以「三坊一照壁、四合五天井」為特徵，一般為土木磚石結構，其中著名的有楊家院、董家院、嚴家院等民居。

📍 Hỷ Châu Cổ Trấn - Xizhou Ancient Town, Dali, Yunnan, China Một cổ trấn yên bình mang đậm dấu ấn văn hóa của dân tộc Bạch – Hỷ Châu không quá đông đúc như Đại Lý cổ trấn nhưng lại giữ được vẻ đẹp nguyên bản, mộc mạc và chân thực hơn rất nhiều. Những căn nhà cổ với kiến trúc Bạch tộc độc đáo, con ngõ nhỏ lát đá, tiếng chuông gió leng keng và mùi trà thơm thoảng qua mỗi quán nhỏ. ⏰ Nên đi buổi sáng sớm để cảm nhận sự thanh bình, hoặc chiều muộn để ngắm hoàng hôn trên cánh đồng ven cổ trấn. 🍵 Đừng quên ghé thử trà ba đạo – một nghi lễ trà đặc trưng của người Bạch. 📸 Rất nhiều góc sống ảo vintage, phù hợp với ai mê chụp ảnh hoặc thích không gian yên tĩnh. ⚠️ Lưu ý: Buổi trưa nắng khá gắt, nhớ mang theo mũ/nón và nước. Một điểm dừng chân đáng giá nếu bạn yêu thích văn hóa bản địa và muốn thoát khỏi sự xô bồ du lịch hóa.

Hỷ Châu Cổ Trấn, cái đầu tiên mình bất ngờ là ở đây khá là bé, một vài điểm đặc trưng là có chợ nhỏ, bán trái cây, đồ chiên, và một số món khác. NHƯNG điểm nổi bật là cầu đá hồ sen này, quả thật là một kiệt tác, chỉ tiếc là mình không có người yêu để chụp những tấm hình cho nhân ở đây chỉ chụp được cảnh thôi
特色古鎮，大理文化發祥地之一，是白族聚集區域，古鎮不收費，但如果要參觀嚴家大院，就要買門票62人民幣。風景很不錯，建築很有特色，可以慢慢吃吃逛逛，喜洲粑粑必吃。可惜遊客實在太多，逛起來少了點愜意的感覺

這次去到中國，其實因為逛了麗江古鎮又逛了大理古鎮，那後來排到這個喜洲古鎮的時候其實我不抱什麼很大的希望，加上去的時候天氣也很熱，所以最後我們11個人就決定就參加他們的導覽，這樣子有車子坐也不用走太久，但經過導遊小姐的介紹，了解了這個古鎮的歷史也看了很多他們的標記建築物，真的覺得來對了地方，我建議如果去旅行的朋友，可以參加他們的導覽，這是我們這次去中國自由行唯一參加的一個導覽活動，真的真的非常值得也聽了很多的故事，也看到了當初首富的房子 還蠻有趣的，古鎮內也有很多就是不同的東西像是有好吃的冰棒，還有一些當地的特色商品，不是其他古鎮很觀光化，推薦給大家去看看😊

喜洲镇 Phố cổ Hỷ Châu Phố cổ Hỷ Châu nằm ở phía bắc thành phố Đại Lý, tựa vào núi Thương Sơn ở phía tây và hồ Nhĩ Hải ở phía đông. Nó là 1 thị trấn lịch sử và văn hóa nổi tiếng của tỉnh Vân Nam. Phố cổ Hỷ Châu có rất nhiều di tích văn hóa và danh lam thắng cảnh. Đây là thị trấn du lịch nổi tiếng mang đậm bản sắc dân tộc. Mặc dù bữa giờ đi toàn cổ trấn nhưng nhìn Phố cổ Hỷ Châu vẫn chưa thấy ngán, vì nó vẫn có nét đẹp riêng. Những điểm check in chính: ✅喜洲正义门进古镇 Cổng Zhengyi. ✅古榕树 Cây đa cổ thụ khoảng 500 năm tuổi, từ cổng đi vào là thấy. ✅转角楼 Tòa nhà góc: đứng trên tầng 2 chụp xuống rất đẹp. ✅麦田 Cánh đồng lúa mì: cánh đồng rất rộng và có nhiều khu, khu gần bức tường hồng là đông người nhất. Bên canh đó có toa tàu đang thi công và gần hoạt động, ngồi trên tàu xong đi tham quan trong cánh đồng chắc thích lắm. Tưởng tượng thôi đã mê rồi.

Một cổ trấn nhỏ tại tp Đại Lý. Chúng tôi tới tham quan vào 1 ngày mưa tháng 6. Thời tiết khá mát mẻ, trong khoảng 20 độ, phù hợp với việc đi dạo bộ trong khu làng cổ. Tuy nhiên, do có mưa nên việc chụp ảnh cũng ít nhiều bị ảnh hưởng khiến chúng tôi ko có được nhiều bức ảnh đẹp.
